## 🛍️ AI Product Listing Generator (Daraz / Shopify)
Add products to the `Products` tab (SKU, facts, public **Photo URL**, Status **To-do**) → AI looks at the photo and writes an SEO title, 5 highlights, description, specs and keywords → row updated to **Review**.

**Needs:** OpenAI (vision model), Google Sheets.

**Setup (once)**
1. Import this file: n8n → *Workflows* → *⋯* → **Import from File**.
2. Open **Settings** and fill in your details.
3. Connect credentials on the nodes with a ⚠️ (OpenAI, Google Sheets, Gmail…).
4. In every Google Sheets node pick your sheet + tab (template: *Skillstack-AI-Workflows-Sheets.xlsx*).
5. **Test workflow**, then switch **Active** on.
**Bulk upload:** copy the reviewed columns into the Daraz Bulk Manager template or Shopify product CSV. Always check specs against the real product.
